deficits.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing on the right side to improve safety for pedestrians crossing this busy urban street.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the road to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing the wide, busy street.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing points to improve accessibility for pedestrians and wheelchair users.
Enhance street lighting around the crossing areas to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
